item.title: Bassett Network Addresses ICE Rumors
item.description: “Immigration and Customs Enforcement was not at Bassett Medical Center, despite rumors and misinformation spreading through the community,” spokesperson Gabrielle Argo said in a statement.

item.title: Bassett Network Welcomes New Director of Bassett Research Institute
item.description: Malone’s appointment follows a national search for the next leader of the Bassett Research Institute’s mission. He succeeds Dr. Anne Gadomski, who retired after serving more than 28 years at the Bassett Research Institute, six of them as director.
